basic_info.description: Bright top floor condo w/ 2BD, 1BA, flexible sunroom/office & 2 garages on an extra large lot in the Inner Mission w/ a 100 walk score. Bay windows bring in ample natural light to living room & adjacent dining room, offering ideal flow for entertaining. Stylish kitchen w/ sleek counters, painted cabinets, ssl appliances, handsome tile & adjacent laundry room with stairs to backyard. Peaceful primary BD w/ large closet & 2nd BD both adjoin a sunroom w/ windows overlooking the backyarda cozy space for a den, office, 3rd BD or other use. Split BA w/ clawfoot tub/shower. Coved ceilings, wood floors, built-in cabinets & plenty of storage closets. Huge shared backyard w/ multiple areas for lounging & entertaining. 2 separate garages offer flexibility for parking, storage, office, artist studio, or income. Private gated front entry. Located in a 3-unit building at the intersection of Bernal Heights, Inner Mission & Noe Valley. Vibrant living near restaurants, transit, BART, freeways, shops, Whole Foods, parks & nightlife. With ample flexible spaces, this condo offers a winning blend of timeless style & modern functionality w/ outdoor living & a dynamic location for enjoying city life.
